title: canavalia ensiformis var. normalis
intro: Canavalia ensiformis var. normalis, commonly known as jack bean or sword bean, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family, native to tropical Asia and the Pacific Islands. The health benefits of jack bean include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, manage diabetes, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. Therapeutically, jack bean has been reported to have antioxidant, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancer actions due to its ability to inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of jack bean include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
